# CSOAI - Council for the Safety of AI

## About

CSOAI (Council for the Safety of AI) is an independent UK standards body building the sovereign AI governance substrate. We are CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677, based in London, United Kingdom.

Founded by Nicholas Templeman, SVP and Director at CSGA Cyber AI Research Institute.

## The Charter Article 0

"Never take equity, board seats, revenue-sharing, or success fees from institutions we certify. S&P paid $1.375B and Moody's paid $864M in settlements for this exact conflict. ISO fee-for-service model ONLY. CA3O is the CMMC for AI — independent third-party accreditation."

## The One-Liner

"CA3O is the CMMC for AI."

## The 12-Layer Sovereign Stack

1. Identity (W3C DID v1)
2. Attestation (Ed25519-signed Watchdog Certificates)
3. Policy (PDCA runtime, 30 crosswalks)
4. Payment (x402, planned Q3 2026)
5. Audit (SIGIL chain, hash-chained, publicly verifiable)
6. Council (BFT multi-stakeholder, pickable setups)
7. Sectors (CASA 1-4 certification, 6 sectors)
8. Frameworks (30 crosswalks: EU AI Act, NIST, ISO, DORA, ...)
9. Agents (47 sovereign AI personalities)
10. Town (Awareness v2 + Absorption v3)
11. Sovereign (M4 Mac + GCP VM, not Big Tech)
12. Authority (Magna Carta for AI)

|---|---|---|---|

## The BFT Council (Pickable)

5 setups end user can pick:
- BFT-LITE (3-of-5, startups, ~10ms)
- BFT-STANDARD (12-of-22, mid-size orgs, ~25ms)
- BFT-STRICT (22-of-33, sovereign entities, ~50ms)
- BFT-PARLIAMENT (50-of-100, multilateral, ~100ms)
- BFT-CUSTOM (bespoke)

Mapped to CASA levels 1-4.

Hosted on openpatent.ai.

## The API v1 Specification

Base URL: https://api.csoai.org/v1
Auth: Bearer (Watchdog Cert)

- POST /certificates/issue
- GET /certificates/{id}

## The 7-Dimensional Dose-Response (the proof)

649M-episode flywheel simulation, Ed25519-signed, hash-chained.

- 0% enforcement: 677 crimes/cycle
- 25% enforcement: 400 (-41%)
- 50% enforcement: 225 (-67%)
- 75% enforcement: 27 (-96%)
- 100% enforcement: 0 (-100%)

~25× reduction at 75% enforcement. Verified by Claude TUI.
